verdict.rationale: Puzzle has a documented 'How to setup your Puzzle MCP' help article confirming an official MCP server exists, and Puzzle is not itself an agent, so the axis applies and is credited on the vendor side. However, there's no detail on setup depth, supported tools/capabilities, or any independent/hands-on confirmation that it works as claimed. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of MCP server capabilities/tools exposed, independent or hands-on verification of the MCP server working, and clarity on authentication/setup specifics.
